corpus.evidence: no vulnerable/safe corpus authored beside this record; fixtures live in the plugin's own tests.

oracle.evidence: no independent decider. SonarQube computes the same metric and is the obvious one.
oracle.command: score findings against sonarjs on the same corpus

effectiveFp.evidence: not measured under the formal protocol. One class is now out of scope by construction. In a single-rule sweep at `error` over the 8 pinned repositories, 111 of 407 findings (27%) were in machine-generated files, and applying the skip removed exactly 27% — 407 -> 296. Under corpus-scan's recommended presets the rule reads 74 against a published budget of 185; that larger gap is not all this change, since the budget also predates other work on the plugin. What remains has not been sampled.

reachability.evidence: not applicable in the taint sense — this is a structural metric, not a source-to-sink question.

duel.evidence: not scored against sonarjs, the direct competitor for this metric.

adversarial.evidence: no wave written against this rule. On the two maintainability rules where one was written it found a real defect in each, so absence of evidence is not evidence here.

realSource.evidence: 8 pinned repositories under scripts/corpus-scan.ts (recommended presets). Published budget 185 -> 74 against the local tree, which is the first measurement here taken against the actual tree — before #612 the rig ran local plugins against the PUBLISHED devkit. scripts/corpus-scan.ts measures under the RECOMMENDED presets; the composition figures come from a single-rule sweep at `error` with default options over the same 8 repositories. Two instruments, two denominators — they are not interchangeable and an earlier draft of this record mixed them.

partition.evidence: probed against the other two maintainability rules that visit the same function nodes. The corpus splits cleanly: identical-functions 258, cognitive-complexity 227, max-parameters 74, none subsuming another.

coverage.evidence: 100% statements / branches / functions / lines across eslint-plugin-maintainability, 405 tests.

knownGaps.summary: the rule does not look at files that declare themselves machine-generated.
knownGaps.why: maintainability advice is addressed to whoever edits the file next, and generated code has no such reader — the next generator run rewrites it wholesale, and twilio-node's header says "Do not edit the class manually" outright. Decided by the file's OWN declaration (an @generated docblock or a "this code was generated by" banner in the LEADING comments), never by whether the path contains the word.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: a generated file is found that carries no banner and the class is large enough to matter.

knownGaps.summary: test files are NOT skipped, unlike identical-functions.
knownGaps.why: deliberate, and the rule-creator records the reasoning: a convoluted test is still a readability cost to whoever debugs it when it fails, so complexity advice applies there in a way duplication advice does not. Duplication in a test IS the test; complexity in a test is not.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: an effectiveFp sample shows test-file findings of this rule going unactioned at the same rate as the generated ones did.

knownGaps.summary: a generated signature's parameter count is decided by the API spec it came from.
knownGaps.why: covered by the generated-code skip, but worth naming separately: even where the file is hand-written, a wrapper mirroring a third-party signature cannot reduce its arity without changing the contract.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: the effectiveFp sample shows this class is large among the remaining 74.

notes: Seal record OPENED 2026-08-22, alongside the change that added skipGeneratedFiles. The generated share was PREDICTED from a single-rule sweep at 27% before the change, and the change removed exactly 27% of that sweep's findings (407 -> 296) — which is the evidence that the predicate silenced the generated set and nothing else, rather than a broader class landing near the same number. scripts/corpus-scan.ts measures under the RECOMMENDED presets; the composition figures come from a single-rule sweep at `error` with default options over the same 8 repositories. Two instruments, two denominators — they are not interchangeable and an earlier draft of this record mixed them.
